row.notes: Builds the R&D DEVELOPMENT POTENTIAL pie + per-dept overview descriptions. Loops k_Career_UpgradeDeptCodeTable but GATED: if(code<4) and if(4<i)break => effectively 4 depts. switch(code) maps 0->aero,1->chassis,2->maintenance,3->engine, default->error_department, with INLINE hardcoded colours 0xffeead00/0xff3ec58d/0xff16deff/0xff7a2aed (default white). Writes per-dept entries at base+0x6b0 stride 0x220. Hardcoded 4, independent of the dept data model. Class A (vt_Career_RnDResearchViewModel 0x14575e000, Team HQ research overview); constructs its object with Career_Construct_RnDPieObject @0x141f41e56 and move-assigns it @0x141f41e7d like class B.
